thread:
alyssa: heads up — ZeptoCloud just pushed Q3 preorder lead times. APAC shipments moving from ~6w to 9-10w. we have several Dedicated preorders on the affected manifests (Order ZP-9874). need mitigation plan asap.

mike: saw their note. called their logistics rep — they can do a split ship: ~50% out in 6w, remainder 10-12w. cause: port congestion + missing customs paperwork on a vendor batch.

vanessa: which customers are impacted? need to map to committed reserved capacity (SLA).

alyssa: quick list: AcmeProd (Q3 launch), FinGraph (reserved 24/7), HealthAI (private deploy). All have dedicated commit windows.

raj: we can request an emergency EU pull from Zepto's Rotterdam staging: add ~$12k in freight and customs expedite. Lead time to arrange ~48h.

jess: is there any alternate partner inventory we can tap? ByteRack had some available in EU last week but their manifest was noisy.

mike: ByteRack can provide up to 30% of the quantity for the same SKU, but they'd require a marketplace swap and new serial reconciliation. marketplace-bot: NOTE: marketplace swap requires updated PO + serial import CSV (format: order_id, serial, model, arrival_eta).

orion: product question — for customers running private deployments, can we offer a temporary model routing to a hosted/marketplace variant to avoid service break? we could use routing policy 'burst-credits -> hosted-variant' for short windows.

vanessa: yes for non-data-sensitive tenants (low compliance). HealthAI is regulated, cannot route off private infra. we need to prioritize physical hardware for them.

jess: propose plan: 1) ask Zepto for split ship (accept 50% now). 2) Open ByteRack swap for 30% to cover non-compliant customers. 3) Expedited EU pull for the remaining critical hardware for HealthAI (approve cost). 4) For PLG customers, enable burst tokens to hosted API until RMA complete.

alyssa: sounds good. budget approval needed for expedited freight — @mike / @raj can you get a delta estimate and signoff path?

mike: I'll run numbers. rough estimate: expedited EU pull $12k, ByteRack swap premium ~$6k, courier expedite for docs $1.2k. total ~19.2k.

raj: logistics note — Zepto requires corrected commercial invoice + HTS codes before release. if Legal can fast-track signatures, we can shave 4-5 days.

orion: rollback plan for product: if hardware backlog exceeds 4 weeks we gate non-critical rollouts and open canary on hosted endpoints. send a message to releases channel to pause July rollouts if needed.

jess: I'll open the swap request with ByteRack and push the PO change. tagging @marketplace-bot to generate the serial CSV template.

marketplace-bot: CSV template generated: https://internal/marketplace/csv-template — fields: order_id, serial, sku, model, arrival_eta.

alyssa: action items: mike (costs + procurement signoff), raj (expedite EU pull paperwork), jess (ByteRack swap + PO), vanessa (customer comms + prioritization list), orion (routing fallback + release hold decision). I'll coordinate exec FYI.

vanessa: drafting customer comms now — short, candid, with mitigation options and estimated windows. will call top 3 customers in next 24h.

mike: cost signoff path: need finance PO bump; cc'ing finance in case we need emergency budget.

alyssa: perfect. update here with PO numbers and any firm ETAs. thanks all :thumbsup:
